mathsci.label: Strongly agree

challeng.label: Strongly agree

interest.label: agree

varied.label: agree

highsal.label: disagree

discoura.label: no

wkexp.label: agree

nogain.label: disagree

noplaoth.label: other

noplaoth.reasoning: Main reason for not going: does not intend to work in the industry.

pleased.label: agree
pleased.evidence: No, if I was gonna do any course apart from this, it would be pure maths. So, and that’d be just boring.
pleased.reasoning: Says she is glad she took the course and does not regret it.

practica.label: disagree
practica.evidence: there’s a lot more theory than I expected. I thought there’d be a bit more practice
practica.reasoning: Feels there is too much theory and not enough practical work — level not just right.

practwk.label: dissatisfied
practwk.evidence: they can’t afford to let us do a lot of practical work and run wind tunnels and things all the time
practwk.reasoning: Wanted more practical/lab work than the underfunded department provides.

designwk.label: dissatisfied
designwk.evidence: I thought it would be a bit more design; a bit more erm contact with aeroplanes and a bit more lab work
designwk.reasoning: Expected and wanted more design work than the course delivers.

groupwk.label: very dissatisfied
groupwk.evidence: I absolutely hate it. And they had some pieces of course work, where it was optional, you could do it on your own or do it in a group and share the marks, and I was like I’m doing it on my own. I hate group work.
groupwk.reasoning: Strong, repeated statement that she hates group work and avoids it.

supppers.label: satisfied
supppers.evidence: she told my lecturers and people that my course work was supposed to be handed to, that it wouldn’t all be in on time, that kind of thing. And she was really good with that.
supppers.reasoning: Personal tutor was supportive after a family death and approachable — clearly satisfied.

quality.label: satisfied
quality.evidence: Clearer – easier to understand, she did explain things differently but then every lecturer is like that. So, I found her easier to understand
quality.reasoning: Positive remarks about lecturers' clarity and explanation.

theory.label: dissatisfied
theory.evidence: when you see stuff on paper, and you see more and more on paper, and it’s all based on other stuff you’ve seen on paper, you start to lose track of what stuff actually is
theory.reasoning: Finds the heavy paper-based theory disorienting and would prefer to see things in real life.

carpath.label: design work
carpath.evidence: I think design is more my kind of thing – er more maths and numbers than like cutting up sheets of metal and things.
carpath.reasoning: If staying in the field she prefers design work; though she also leans away from a career in industry.

workrole.label: managerial
workrole.evidence: management would be good – something – I want to progress in whatever I do.
workrole.reasoning: Sees management as desirable and wants to progress, not do the hands-on labour.

furstudy.label: yes
furstudy.evidence: I have actually been looking into a PGCE to look at teacher training
furstudy.reasoning: Considering further study via a PGCE.

studarea.label: PGCE, teaching
studarea.evidence: I have actually been looking into a PGCE to look at teacher training
studarea.reasoning: Specifically a PGCE for teacher training.

salary.label: neither important nor unimportant
salary.evidence: So money – obviously I don’t want to get a degree here to earn the same as someone that has walked straight out of school erm but I – I also, I’m not obsessed with it.
salary.reasoning: Money matters somewhat but she is explicitly not obsessed with it.

location.label: unimportant
location.evidence: location doesn’t bother me at all. Anywhere in the world really
location.reasoning: Location explicitly does not matter to her.

workenv.label: important
workenv.evidence: Oh somewhere where you don’t get your hands dirty.
workenv.reasoning: Cares about the working environment — does not want a dirty, overalls workplace.
